Overview

Wuxi is a city in Jiangsu with a population of 7,462,000. A wealthy city on Lake Taihu, known for its scenic lakeside, historic gardens, and strong manufacturing and solar energy industries. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
